positive_snippets: I had a really pleasant stay here. The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. Staff were polite and always willing to help, especially at reception. The location is convenient, with restaurants and shops nearby. Would definitely stay again

Very good value for money! Hotel is a bit in the middle of nowhere, there's not even a paved road access ... Very dusty and dirty surroundings but that's not why you are here, right? Staff is very nice and helpful. Rooms are very good for the price! Only bigger issue is the quality of bathroom which would need a bit of a revamp.
Wifi worked fine, room is huge, bed is huge, AC worked well.
One more downside is that during my stay (4 nights) there were no cleaning provided, but I believe it would be provided if I would ask for it.
Location is within 10 mins walk from the Golf Course Road, mall and Rapid metro.

Overall something between 3 and 4 stars for me.

Value for money made it 4 stars.

I had an amazing stay at Hotel Lexum! The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure all my needs were met. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The breakfast was delicious, with a great variety of options. I highly recommend Hotel Lexum to anyone visiting the area. I will definitely be coming back!
negative_snippets:
Absolutely disgusting rooms which looked like they hadn't been cleaned at all for a long time. Plaster from the ceiling falling into the floor. Bugs in the room. Cigarettes and rubbish left on the room floor.

Was offered to move room and the second room was equally bad.

Please never ever stay here. I left early and went to stay elsewhere. I was told I would get a refund but have not been given one.
